name: Giovanni Pestocchi
intro: I’m a software developer by day and a culinary artist by night, experimenting in my kitchen. Pesto is my go-to for everything, from pasta to pizza. In my free time, you can catch me binge-watching movies or working out at the gym!

meta.title: Giovanni Pestocchi — Software Developer & Culinary Artist
meta.description: Personal site of Giovanni Pestocchi: software developer, home cook, pesto enthusiast. Projects, writing, and the occasional recipe.

projects.title: Pesto Bot
projects.description: An AI kitchen assistant for pesto lovers. Tell it what's in your pantry — classic basil and pine nuts, or kale and almonds — and it suggests personalised recipes plus pairings for pasta, pizza, and salads.

projects.title: Pesto Power
projects.description: A free mini eBook with 10 pesto recipes — from classic Genovese to wild combos like avocado–pumpkin seed. My homage to the greatest sauce ever invented.

projects.title: Dough Mate
projects.description: An app for perfecting pizza dough. Enter your flour, hydration level, and proofing time; Dough Mate calculates ideal ratios and reminds you when to stretch and fold.

projects.title: Meal Tracker
projects.description: A meal-prep tracker for gym-goers who love food. Log macros, plan weekly meals, and get recipe suggestions including pesto-inspired fitness dishes.

projects.title: Flavor Frame
projects.description: A photography app for food lovers. Smart filters and shot tips make your food pics pop. I use it for Instagram-worthy shots of my pesto pizzas and pastas.

projects.title: Pantry Pal
projects.description: A kitchen-organisation app that helps reduce food waste. Log your pantry, fridge, and freezer; Pantry Pal suggests recipes from what you already have and warns you before things spoil.

projects.title: Pasta Planner
projects.description: A visual tool for designing pasta dishes. Pick a shape, a sauce (pesto always included), and toppings — Pasta Planner generates a step-by-step cooking guide.

projects.title: Cine Snacks
projects.description: Pair the perfect snack with your movie night. Pick a genre and Cine Snacks suggests recipes — pesto popcorn for thrillers, bruschetta for rom-coms, BBQ sliders for action.

projects.title: Greenify
projects.description: A website celebrating fresh herbs in cooking — blog, video tutorials, and a community for sharing recipes. There's a special section just for pesto enthusiasts.

projects.title: Macro Mixer
projects.description: A kitchen-scale app for protein shakes and smoothies. Tracks ingredients so you can balance fitness goals with flavour.

projects.title: Sauce Spot
projects.description: An interactive guide to making sauces from scratch. Pick a cuisine or base (cream, tomatoes, or pesto) and Sauce Spot walks you through your signature sauce.

projects.title: Lift Fuel
projects.description: A blog for fitness foodies. Recipes like high-protein pesto chicken wraps and tips for balancing workouts with indulgent eats — proof you can love food and stay fit.
